
### exercise: ACLs versus chmod 



* which ACL rulesets are possible to imitate with chmod?
 <table>
<tr><td>A.</td><td>
`user:foo:rw-`<br>`user:bar:r--`<br>`user:quux:-w-`<br>`other:---`
</td><td>B.</td><td>
`user:foo:rw-`<br>`user:bar:r--`<br>`user:quux:---`<br>`other:---`
</td></tr>
<tr><td>C.</td><td>
`user:foo:rw-`<br>`user:bar:rw-`<br>`user:quux:r--`<br>`other:r--`
</td><td>D.</td><td>
`user:foo:rw-`<br>`group:G:r--`<br>`user:quux:rw-`<br>`other:---`
</td></tr>
</table>
